title: rosa tomentella subsp. valesiaca
intro: Rosa tomentella subsp. valesiaca, commonly known as alpine rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. The alpine rose is a perennial plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the alpine rose include its ability to calm nervous disorders, reduce fever, and promote digestion. The bioactive constituents of the alpine rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
